plan.title: 18 weeks of steady building
plan.summary: Made by Tartan's own rules, without AI, from about 50 km a week over 17 runs in the last four weeks. 4 days a week with the long run on Sun; about 10% more each week, every fourth week easier. Paces come from what your recent runs say you could race 5 km in (26:30).

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Steady and easy the whole way; it's the time on your feet that counts.

sessions.title: 17 min tempo
sessions.notes: Warm up 12 minutes, then comfortably hard: you could say a few words, not chat. Cool down.

sessions.title: 4 × 3 min
sessions.notes: Warm up 12 minutes, then each 3 minutes at about 5 km race effort with 2 minutes' easy jog between, then cool down.

advice: Easy means easy: if you can't talk in full sentences, slow down.
Feeling run down or sore? Swap a hard session for an easy one, or rest.
With an AI key the coach can take this plan over and adjust it as you train.
